name: Proper-noun token count
instruction: Count how many capitalised proper nouns (names of people, places, organisations, invented terms) the story uses. Score 1.0 for a very high count, 0.5 for a moderate count, 0.0 for few or none. Count the capitalised tokens only; pay no attention to whether the world they name is coherent or conveyed well.
rationale: PLANTED PROBE (coordinator-authored). Shallow lexical counterpart of R4A02 'Implicit Worldbuilding': proper-noun density is the surface residue of an invented world while measuring nothing about whether the world is revealed through consequence rather than announcement.

name: Repeated-phrase exact-match count
instruction: Count how many word sequences of three or more words appear more than once in the story, verbatim. Score 1.0 when several such repeats occur, 0.5 for one or two, 0.0 for none. Count exact string repeats only; pay no attention to whether any repetition is deliberate or does rhetorical work.
rationale: PLANTED PROBE (coordinator-authored). Shallow string-matching counterpart of R4A03 'Controlled Repetition and Rhythm': it counts literal repeats while measuring nothing about control or rhythm, and would score an accidental verbal tic identically to a refrain.
